        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int a[] = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        // dp[i][sum][odd][count] for i from 0 to n, but we only use i from 1 to n-1
        int[][][][] dp = new int[n+1][101][101][101];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < 101; s++) {
                for (int o = 0; o < 101; o++) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < 101; c++) {
                        dp[i][s][o][c] = -1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // base: i == n, all states are 0
        for (int s = 0; s < 101; s++) {
            for (int o = 0; o < 101; o++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < 101; c++) {
                    dp[n][s][o][c] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        // bottom-up from i = n-1 down to 1
        for (int i = n-1; i >= 1; i--) {
            for (int sum = 0; sum < 101; sum++) {
                for (int odd = 0; odd < 101; odd++) {
                    for (int count = 0; count < 101; count++) {
                        int p1 = 0, p2 = 0;
                        if (sum + Math.abs(a[i] - a[i-1]) <= k && count - odd == odd) {
                            p1 = 1 + dp[i+1][sum + Math.abs(a[i] - a[i-1])][a[i] % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0][1];
                        }
                        p2 = dp[i+1][sum][odd + (a[i] % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0)][count + 1];
                        dp[i][sum][odd][count] = Math.max(p1, p2);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int ans = dp[1][0][a[0] % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0][1];
        out.println(ans);
        out.close();
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private InputStream stream;
        private byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
        private int curChar;
        private int numChars;
        private BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        public int read() {
            if (numChars==-1)
                throw new InputMismatchException();
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try {
                    numChars = stream.read(buf);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new InputMismatchException();
                }
                if(numChars <= 0)
                    return -1;
            }
            return buf[curChar++];
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            int c = read();
            while(isSpaceChar(c))
                c = read();
            int sgn = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sgn = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            int res = 0;
            do {
                if(c<'0'||c>'9')
                    throw new InputMismatchException();
                res *= 10;
                res += c - '0';
                c = read();
            } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
            return res * sgn;
        }

        public boolean isSpaceChar(int c) {
            return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
        }
    }
